# cubepath_firewall_groups (Data Source)

Fetches all firewall groups for the user's organization



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) List of firewall groups (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the firewall group is enabled
- `id` (Number) Firewall group ID
- `name` (String) Firewall group name
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID this firewall group belongs to
- `rules` (Attributes List) Firewall rules in this group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups--rules))
- `vps_count` (Number) Number of VPS instances using this firewall group

<a id="nestedatt--groups--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups.rules`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Rule comment
- `direction` (String) Direction of traffic
- `port` (String) Port specification
- `protocol` (String) Protocol
- `source` (String) Source IP or CIDR
